name: Malachi
title: Malachi — My Messenger
tagline: Where is the God of justice? He is coming.
purpose: Confront polluted worship; promise refining messenger and Day.
christ: Messenger of the covenant; sun of righteousness; John the Baptist as Elijah figure (Matt 11).
spirit: Refiner’s fire purifying sons of Levi.
jesus_in_this_book: Messenger of the covenant; sun of righteousness; John the Baptist as Elijah figure (Matt 11).
how_to_read: Last OT word — hungers for NT dawn.
watchman_charge: Stop robbing God. Stop treacherous divorce. Fear the Name before the Day.
mbt_note: Primary voice NKJV; parallels as engine shows.
